description: This file defines a custom exception class 'IncorrectPasswordException' used in the account exception package of the book project. It extends RuntimeException and is annotated with a custom annotation to exclude it from Jacoco code coverage reports.

classes.name: IncorrectPasswordException
classes.description: Custom runtime exception indicating an incorrect password scenario in the application.

methods.name: IncorrectPasswordException
methods.description: Constructor that accepts an error message and passes it to the superclass RuntimeException.
